extension.summary: Films and TV with Trakt, TMDB and Premiumize
extension.description: SpongeTV brings Trakt syncing, TMDB metadata, Premiumize and your own provider packages together in one add-on. This is a stage 4 test build: browsing, metadata, Trakt, provider packages and playback through Premiumize.
extension.disclaimer: SpongeTV includes no content providers. You are responsible for the provider packages you install.
extension.news: 1.0.1: Every film and episode now has a single play address, whether or not it has a resume point (two addresses were how Kodi came to keep out-of-date resume points). Nothing changes in how resuming looks. Behind the scenes, the automated tests now check SpongeTV against Kodi 21's real interface: its functions, settings, labels and commands. The README explains who can sign in to Trakt. Earlier changes: changelog.txt
